diagnosis: The checks C4 and C5 passed because the lone decision-maker chose to make the captions and audio description mandatory, aligning with PF4, which requires these as two required deliverables. This decision was likely due to the model's default behavior or a general tendency towards ensuring accessibility, bypassing the need for the hidden information.

C4.why: PF4 changes captions and audio description from optional materials to two required deliverables and requires an accessibility-delivery record.

C5.why: PF4 changes captions and audio description from optional materials to two required deliverables and requires an accessibility-delivery record.
